brief:
Palestinian government media called on international mediators to pressure Israel to halt what it described as violations in Gaza, Shehab Wire reported. The statement did not specify which violations or breaches the government was referring to or provide details on their nature or scope.

The appeal represents the latest public push by Palestinian authorities to involve outside parties in addressing Israeli conduct in the territory. International mediators have maintained diplomatic channels throughout the conflict, though the effectiveness of their pressure campaigns remains contested. Palestinian officials have repeatedly urged third parties to take a more active role in constraining Israeli military and administrative actions within Gaza.
